title: Robinson Crusoe
author: Daniel Defoe
summary: A young Englishman defies his father to go to sea and is eventually shipwrecked alone on a remote island. He spends decades there making tools, growing food and thinking about his own life.
readIf: you like survival stories centred on practical detail, planning and solitude.
skipIf: you want fast action or modern attitudes; it is an early novel with colonial and slave-trading views.

pairings.reason: A modern, much shorter survival story about a boy alone in the wilderness, with similar focus on resourcefulness.
Another castaway story, but one in which survival turns into something philosophical and strange.
Asks what happens when people are stranded on an island, with a far bleaker answer.
